Markets.title: Central Bank of India Q2 profit rises 21% as loans grow 30%
Markets.summary: Central Bank of India reported a 21% increase in its September 2026 quarterly net profit to Rs 1,469 crore, driven by a 30% expansion in loans and a 26% growth in net interest income. Additionally, the bank's asset quality improved as its net non-performing assets (NPA) declined to 0.31%.

Markets.title: Rising borrowing costs signal funding risks for global AI expansion: Jefferies report
Markets.summary: Rising borrowing costs are increasing credit risks and funding challenges for companies investing in artificial intelligence infrastructure, such as Oracle and CoreWeave. Investors should monitor credit spreads to evaluate whether these AI projects can maintain their financing.

Markets.title: AI race may depend more on access to power, infrastructure than chip supply: Morgan Stanley
Markets.summary: Morgan Stanley warns that the AI industry faces a 32-gigawatt electricity shortfall by 2028 that will threaten data-center development. This impending power deficit could create severe infrastructure challenges for smaller enterprises trying to compete with larger companies.

Markets.title: ixigo Q2 profit at Rs 63 cr on robust show in hotel booking biz
Markets.summary: Ixigo reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 63.42 crore for the September quarter, recovering from a net loss of Rs 3.46 crore in the previous year. This financial turnaround was driven by a surge in hotel bookings and resulted in an operational revenue of Rs 320.96 crore.

Markets.title: ICICI Bank Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 14,843 crore, NII rises 18%
Markets.summary: ICICI Bank reported a 20.1% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rs 14,843 crore for the second quarter of financial year 2027. During the same period, the private lender's net interest income (NII) rose by 18%.

Markets.title: IDBI Bank Q2 results: Net profit tanks 39% YoY to Rs 2,205 crore; NII dips 49% YoY
Markets.summary: IDBI Bank reported a 39% year-on-year drop in Q2 net profit to Rs 2,205 crore, primarily due to a one-off gain in the previous year. Despite the headline profit decline, the bank saw improvements in asset quality, deposit and advance growth, and sequential net interest margins.

Geo-Political.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
Geo-Political.summary: Over 1,000 people were arrested in France following violent clashes, looting, and arson during nationwide demonstrations. More than half a million citizens participated in the protests, which centered on the cost of living.

Geo-Political.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump temporarily waived several recently passed congressional sanctions against Russia, citing national security concerns. This decision coincides with an intensifying political dispute between Trump and Ukrainian President Zelensky.

Geo-Political.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli settlers attacked European diplomats in the West Bank. The Israeli military condemned the violence, but the prime minister's office called it a smear campaign.

Geo-Political.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
Geo-Political.summary: Anti-government protesters clashed violently with riot police throughout Saturday in Tirana, Albania. The unrest caused significant conflict between the demonstrators and law enforcement authorities in the capital.

Geo-Political.title: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
Geo-Political.summary: At least 17 people have died and numerous others were injured during a crush at a Hindu festival event. The tragic incident occurred in the Indian city of Kolkata.

Geo-Political.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
Geo-Political.summary: Satellite images show a luxury boat equipped with a 50-meter pool and water slides stationed near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat in North Korea. This display of wealth contrasts sharply with the extreme poverty experienced by the majority of North Korean citizens.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Jio’s mega debut, deferred UPI charges, IDBI bank stake sale
Data & Insights.summary: This week's data compilation from Mint highlights Jio's major market debut, deferred UPI charges, and the ongoing stake sale of IDBI Bank. The report features easy-to-read charts providing deeper insights into these key financial developments.

Data & Insights.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga warned that 1.2 billion young people will enter the global workforce over the next decade against only 400 million projected jobs. To address this and other challenges, the institution plans to increase critical minerals financing to $19 billion through fiscal 2030 and mobilize more private capital.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Five ITI clusters will receive ₹1,195 crore in investments from companies including Tata Steel Foundation and BVG India under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the total approved funding under the initiative to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The Government of Goa is hosting a three-day business summit from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium. The event will connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will boost productivity over time while potentially raising short-term inflation. He also warned that economic uncertainty and the transition to this technology could lead to a bumpy road ahead.

Data & Insights.title: India may hike fuel prices in November, pushing inflation above RBI target: Oxford Economist
Data & Insights.summary: Oxford Economics reports that India may moderately increase fuel prices in November before upcoming state elections. This price hike is expected to push inflation above the Reserve Bank of India's target.

India.title: 4 Killed After Part Of Chimney Collapses At Power Plant In Bengal's Asansol
India.summary: Four people were killed when a section of a chimney collapsed at a power plant in Asansol, West Bengal. Several other workers managed to escape the accident safely.

India.title: 13 Women, 1 Child Among 18 Killed In Kolkata Durga Puja Pandal Stampede
India.summary: A stampede at a Durga Puja pandal in Kolkata resulted in the deaths of 18 people, including 13 women and one child. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed grief over the tragedy and announced an interim compensation of Rs 2 lakh for the victims' families.

India.title: Darkness, Rush, And An Announcement: What We Know About Kolkata Stampede
India.summary: A deadly stampede occurred in Kolkata, resulting in the deaths of 13 women and a child. The incident was marked by darkness, a heavy rush, and a public announcement.

India.title: Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede: Examining CCTV, Won't Spare Anyone, Says Suvendu Adhikari
India.summary: Following a Durga Puja stampede in Kolkata, Suvendu Adhikari announced that authorities are examining CCTV footage and will hold responsible parties accountable. Adhikari, along with Health Minister Saradwat Mukherjee and senior officials, rushed to the hospital following the incident.

India.title: 'Mother Died Right Before My Eyes': Witnesses Recount Kolkata Durga Puja Pandal Stampede
India.summary: Witnesses at a Kolkata Durga Puja pandal reported a stampede caused by narrow entry and exit gates and poor lighting. The incident resulted in injuries to attendees, including family members of local residents.

India.title: 'Not An Ordinary Foreigner': Imran Khan In Challenge To 'Leave India' Notice
India.summary: Actor Imran Khan has challenged a notice to leave India by arguing that his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card status prevents him from being treated as an ordinary foreigner. He maintains that his legal status cannot be restricted without giving him a fair opportunity to be heard.

General.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
General.summary: More than 500,000 people participated in cost-of-living protests across France that resulted in violent clashes, looting, and burning buildings. Police arrested over 1,000 individuals amidst the nationwide unrest.

General.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France
General.summary: Demonstrations across France turned violent as cars and buildings were set on fire. Rioters also ransacked shops during the widespread disorder.

General.title: More NHS staff sacked over attacks victims' records
General.summary: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust has fired multiple staff members for improperly accessing the medical records of attack victims. The trust announced that a new security system will be implemented to better protect patient records.

General.title: Swinney's emotional explanation for his commitment to independence
General.summary: John Swinney delivered an emotional SNP conference speech focusing on his dedication to Scottish independence. BBC Scotland's political editor Glenn Campbell analyzed the key themes and emotional depth of the address.
